message.content:
**Average (median) house price in California – 2023**

| Metric | Value | Source |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Median home price (overall CA) | **≈ $800 000** | Zillow, *Zillow Home Value Index* (2023) |
| Median home price (Los Angeles County) | ≈ $1 200 000 | Zillow |
| Median home price (San Francisco Bay Area) | ≈ $1 400 000 | Zillow |
| Median home price (San Diego County) | ≈ $950 000 | Zillow |
| Median home price (Rural/Interior CA) | ≈ $500 000 | Zillow |

> **Why “median” is used**  
> The median is the most common statistic reported for housing markets because it is less affected by a few extremely expensive or inexpensive properties. The “average” (mean) price would be slightly higher—roughly **$850 000–$900 000**—but the median is what most buyers, sellers, and analysts refer to.

### Quick Take‑away
- **California’s median home price in 2023 was about $800 k.**  
- Prices vary widely: coastal and Bay Area homes are 2–3× higher than interior or rural areas.  
- The median price has been rising steadily over the past decade, driven by limited inventory and high demand.

**Links for deeper dive**  
- [Zillow Home Value Index – California](https://www.zillow.com/research/data/)  
- [Redfin Market Trends – California](https://www.redfin.com/California)  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown by county or city!
